review_kind: Read-only comparison of ordinary public official HTTP assets. No account, match connection or server execution.
pin_policy: This review does not replace official-v1 manifest.json, cards.json, generated C++, fixture sources or their hashes. The executable remains based on the original pinned facts and client.

pinned_assets.client_last_modified_note: The original client Last-Modified/ETag were not retained in the pinned manifest or available original response headers. Null means unknown; the JSON Last-Modified is not reused for JavaScript.

catalog_comparison.method: Compare all source items records at the same array index; official ID is index+1. Compare the union of source keys, preserving omitted fields. All changes are listed below.
catalog_comparison.execution_pool_impact: No numerical, effect, price, eligibility or distribution changes for the v18/v19 subset: 214 models, normalized gift weight437. Labels/image paths still differ for the three listed models.
catalog_comparison.other_locale_changes: Spanish language/translation credit entries were added. game.cost became a short label with new game.costMP; game.price was replaced by game.priceCP. No item effect descriptions changed in this Japanese locale comparison.

removal_client_review.line_number_basis: One-based lines of the complete assets identified above. Identifiers are compiler-generated and must be resolved separately for each client hash.

regions.finding: Same event wire keys and item arrays/default empty arrays; nested item decoder keeps id/modelId/fakeModelId/used.
Same item-array rendering path and timing/control flow; helper calls ds/e6 renamed dr/e5.
Same rendering and used-miracle panel update; helpers ds/e8/e6 renamed dr/e7/e5.

Iterate event.items in received order, preserving duplicate copies and count. Draw each item for the receiving viewer; only the affected local owner removes the corresponding physical token. Fake models are initially shown when present, then the true-model reveal helper runs. Empty arrays perform zero item iterations.
Read item.modelId and render that actual model after any fake-model display; hand/display method names a5/dK renamed a6/dJ.

removal_client_review.comparison_method: Read the relevant call chains on both versions and compare control structure, operators and literal values after compiler-identifier normalization. This is local inspection, not a full-client execution equivalence proof.
removal_client_review.local_conclusion: No semantic change found in the inspected removal decoder, handlers, ordered rendering or true-model reveal. Their compiler-generated identifiers changed.
removal_client_review.whole_client_audit: Not performed. The complete JavaScript contains widespread compiler-identifier changes and UI changes; this report does not claim the entire client or official server is behaviorally unchanged.
removal_client_review.evidence_scope: A viewer that receives the removal event is shown the event item models in order, including a true-model reveal for fake items. This supports exposing resolved removed model IDs in the scoped local Match; it does not disclose unremoved inventory.

unverified_and_experimental: Official server event fanout is not established by the public client. Unconditional rendering on receipt does not prove every player or spectator receives every removal event.
An empty event.items array is accepted and rendered without item iterations. It is not established that the server always emits a removal event for an empty result.
The local removal draw order, per-copy bounded RNG consumption, empty-no-draw behavior and gift scheduling remain explicit experimental rules rather than verified server behavior.

Local last_removal records only a resolved body, including an empty result. In the current single-body205/206 scope it is retained after action completion and resolved cutoff, then clears on the next accepted main command, reset or load_scene; an unresolved cutoff leaves it null. Its lifetime is a local observation contract, not a public-client/server lifetime guarantee.
The public local event omits physical tokens, original inventory slots, candidate population, RNG state/tickets and future outcomes. This review adds no permission to expose those values.
archive_policy: Only hashes, HTTP validators, metadata differences and research conclusions are archived here. No complete official locale text, JavaScript implementation or image assets are bundled.
